relations.description: NAS security mode control procedure includes receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message
Receipt of SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message stops timer T3460
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message may contain Replayed NAS container message IE
Replayed NAS container may contain ATTACH REQUEST message
Replayed NAS container may contain TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message
Completion of NAS security mode control procedure establishes integrity protection
Completion of NAS security mode control procedure establishes ciphering
MME shall integrity protect and encipher all signalling messages after security mode completion
